projects.title: RunAlong
projects.body:
Well, I signed up to run a marathon. A good idea? Who knows. Only time will tell (by time, I mean we'll know by Sunday). In good news, I have some friends coming to watch (yay)! But how, in the vast land of San Francisco, will they know where I am? Whether I'm still alive and kicking? So, with the new powers of GPT 5.6 Sol, I decided to build an app. And well, 5.6 Sol was cooking something. Not only does this have impeccable UI, but several incredible features: 

- Create public or passcode-protected races of any distance
- Live GPS location, pace, distance, progress, and finish estimate
- Anonymous spectators through the iOS app or website
- Live runner messages and manual force updates
- Background tracking with offline and stale-location warnings
- Save, resume, and finish races from My Races
- Shareable race links—no app required for spectators

Regardless of how the race goes, at least I've gotten a cool app out of it. And I'll update (or not...) soon after.
